claims.necessity_reason: The harness attempts to read through the end of a PNG, but the supplied functions do not establish whether its second row-initialization call permits that read to reach supported compressed metadata after IDAT. The supplied iCCP handler explicitly rejects iCCP after IDAT; the other possible compressed-metadata handlers are missing.
